notes.title: Notice on Fishing Tool Paste Effects Issue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212740/c29d67bc6d8505c804d977373e5662a3b6c74971.png[/img]

Enter into the Endless Possibility!
Hello, Admirals.

While looking into in-game issues, we found that the effects for different grades of Paste were not being applied correctly.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by this issue. 
Please see below for more details on the issue. 

Issue Details
- Issue where all Paste effects were applied the same as ‘Cheap Paste’ since the game’s global launch
ㄴ Affected Tools: Cheap Paste, Intermediate Paste, Superior Paste, Notable Paste, Legendary Paste

Measures and Compensation
- The issue will be fixed through a Emergency maintenance on Jun. 09 (Fri).
  We apologize again for the inconvenience caused. We will be sending the compensation below to all Admirals as an apology. 

■ Compensation
1) Schedule: 2023/06/09 19:10 ~ 2023/06/12 19:10 (UTC+9)
2) Compensation
- Superior Mate Ticket x5, Legendary Paste x30, Legendary Fishing Rod x30

Once the issue is resolved, the different effects for different Paste grades will be applied correctly. 

We apologize for the delay in identifying and resolving this issue.
We will carry out more thorough internal checks and work hard to prevent another issue like this occurring again.

We will always strive to ensure the reliability and quality of Uncharted Waters Origin.

Thank you.

[b]Enter into the Endless Possibility![/b]
Hello, Admirals.

We have confirmed that there is an issue where the install button is currently not showing on Steam.

[strike]We are currently looking into the issue and will work to resolve it as quickly as we can.[/strike]
This issue on Steam has now been resolved, and you can now install the game normally.

[b]Current Situation[/b]
* This issue is only appearing for new installations of the game.
* Admirals who already own the game in their Library or have it installed can access and play the game normally.

[b]How to Still Play the Game[/b]
* You can play Uncharted Waters Origin through FLOOR, as well as Steam.
* Please play the game through FLOOR until the issue is resolved.
* You can connect to Steam after playing through FLOOR. Please see the notices linked below for more details.

notes.title: Gear Error when Mate Yan Shiqi is Acquired
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212740/c29d67bc6d8505c804d977373e5662a3b6c74971.png[/img]

[b]Enter into the Endless Possibility![/b]
Hello, Admirals.

We have confirmed an error where the ‘Yan Shiqi’ Mate was equipped with two A Grade Gear when obtained using the ‘Yan Chest’ Pick-Up gacha mechanic, which started on Mar. 15 (Wed) 00:00 (UTC+9).

Therefore, these Gears will be retrieved and replaced with Base Gear.
Please see below for more details.

[b]Details on Replacing Relevant Gear with Base Gear

 - Gear to be Retrieved:[/b] The 2 Gears that are equipped when Yan Shiqi is acquired through Pick-Up – Yan Shiqi's Attire and Yan Shiqi's Guanmao
[b] - Retrieval Date: [/b]Gear will be retrieved all at once and replaced with Base Gear during the March scheduled maintenance
  * Even if you equip the relevant Gear to another Mate, the Gear will still be replaced with Base Gear.
  * The issue where the Yan Shiqi Gear icon is not displayed will also be fixed during the March scheduled maintenance.

We apologize again for the inconvenience caused by this issue, and will continue to work hard to ensure that we can provide players with more reliable services.

Thank you.

notes.title: Mate Pass Available to Purchase for Limited Period of Time
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212740/c29d67bc6d8505c804d977373e5662a3b6c74971.png[/img]
Enter into the Endless Possibility!
Hello, Admirals.

We identified an issue where the wrong rewards were available for the Mate Pass, which was a product that was added through the Mar. 14 (Tue) temporary maintenance.

Consequently, the sale of the product was quickly suspended.

We would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience that was caused by this issue.

As many Admirals showed much support for the Mate Pass during the short time it was available to purchase, 

we have decided to sell the Mate Pass for a limited period of time instead of changing the product despite the fact that the incorrect rewards were of a higher level than the correct rewards.

The Mate Pass is a Privilege product that gives rewards based on players’ total days at seas to help them with their growth,

and was designed to be necessary for all Admirals who play Uncharted Waters Origin.

So that we can help our global Admirals enjoy Uncharted Waters Origin even more, the Mate Pass will be available to purchase for a limited period of time until Mar. 29 (Wed).

Changes to Mate Pass Sales Period

1. Affected Product: Mate Pass
2. Sales Period: After the patch on Mar. 14 (Tue) – Until before the Mar. 29 (Wed) maintenance (UTC+9)
*A set number of game play hours is needed to obtain all the conditional rewards of the Mate Pass.

As the product will no longer be available to purchase after the Mar. 29 (Wed) maintenance, please make sure you have enough time to play for the rewards before purchasing the product.

We will always strive to ensure that we offer the best game to Admirals.

Thank you.

tags.bug: We identified an issue where the wrong rewards were available for the Mate Pass, which was a product that was added through the Mar. 14 (Tue) temporary maintenance.

notes.title: Cross Platform Account Linking (FLOOR/Steam)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212740/c29d67bc6d8505c804d977373e5662a3b6c74971.png[/img]

Enter into the Endless Possibility!
Hello, Admirals.

Here is a short guide on how to link your account across platforms so that you can play on your preferred device.
Please check the platform you use and find the relevant information below on how to link your account.

※ Any characters that you do not select to link during the linking process will disappear after you finish linking, and cannot be recovered.

[b][Move to Floor Official Website][/b]
EN: [url=https://uwo.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1678176179486030242]https://uwo.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1678176179486030242[/url]
JP: [url=https://uwo.floor.line.games/jp/bbsCmn/detail/1678175815170002472]https://uwo.floor.line.games/jp/bbsCmn/detail/1678175815170002472[/url]
TW: [url=https://uwo.floor.line.games/tw/bbsCmn/detail/1678175955426002592]https://uwo.floor.line.games/tw/bbsCmn/detail/1678175955426002592[/url]

※ To Note

1. As the characters of the account that is not selected in the account linking process
   will disappear after linking and cannot be recovered, please be careful as you proceed with linking.
2. You cannot access the game on FLOOR, mobile and Steam at the same time after cross platform account linking.
    You may freely go back and forth across the platforms, but you can only access the game on 1 platform at a time.

Thank you.
